consumption_boundary: Operational handoffs are ISOLATED_STAGE_B_INSPECTION_ONLY, have pilot_input_allowed=false, and are rejected by the prospective cache-only handoff boundary.
prospective_non_change: PROSPECTIVE_PREMARKET retains the historical-session 07:30 cutoff and all later assembly/readiness/decision boundaries.
rule: The fixed historical data window and the owner-approved execution-validity interval are independent. Operational verification may execute outside premarket hours but never changes or rolls the historical window.
timestamps: All request, receipt, assembly, publication, backup, and restore timestamps are actual runtime timestamps; historical source-event dates never establish earlier receipt.
